loops.minute_1: Place Dart Monkey, watch Red Bloons approach, earn $1 per pop; immediate feedback loop establishes cash→tower→kill causality
loops.minute_10: 3-5 placements complete, tower diversification (Glue, Farm, Bomb); exploration of which towers counter which bloon types (ceramic vs speed vs armor)
loops.hour_5: Round 50-60 range, 8+ towers active, Tier-5 upgrade decisions; cash pressure forces compromise between scaling existing towers vs new placements
loops.endgame: Freeplay mode Round 81+: MOAB ramping begins (+13% health/speed per round). Progression becomes infinite (target round 100+, hardcore players reach 300+). Paragon towers deployed. Victory condition = survive highest round achievable

objectives.victory_condition: Survive all bloon waves through round 60 (Medium) or round 80 (Hard)
objectives.defeat_condition: Lose all starting lives (150 on Medium, 100 on Hard) before completing target round
objectives.player_goal: Pop bloons to earn cash for tower upgrades and maintain life total

objectives.defeat_condition: Bloons breach defenses and all lives lost to ramping MOAB waves
objectives.player_goal: Achieve highest round number possible; score-based progression indefinitely

games.retention_answer: Freeplay infinite scaling (rounds 1→300+), Paragon towers requiring grinding unlock, bi-weekly balance patches, hero synergy discovery, map + mode variety, per-hero leaderboards

loops.minute_1: Place Sunflower (sun generator), place Peashooter (damage). Collect falling sun, spend to plant. First zombies appear round 1-2, immediate feedback on plant placement effectiveness
loops.minute_10: Levels 2-3 (Night), 6-7 plants unlocked. Add Wall-nut (tank), Squash (AOE), Pea Pod (cheap). First 'seed slot' constraint: can only use ~6 plants of 12 unlocked
loops.hour_5: Levels 25-35 (Roof area), 30+ plants available. Active seed selection = 10 plants chosen per level. Economic pressure: which plants synergize? Sun-gen vs firepower tradeoff
loops.endgame: Survival Endless: unlimited zombie flags arrive. After each flag (10-15 zombies), player replaces seed selection. No round limit. Victory = survive flag N (player-defined score)

objectives.victory_condition: Survive final zombie wave at each level (50 levels across 6 zones: Day/Night/Pool/Fog/Roof/Night Roof)
objectives.defeat_condition: Any zombie reaches left edge of lawn (player house)
objectives.player_goal: Defend lawn by placing plants efficiently, gain sun from sun-flowers and defeated zombies, unlock new plants

objectives.defeat_condition: Zombie overwhelms lawn defenses during any flag wave
objectives.player_goal: Survive as many flag waves as possible; score = flag count reached
Survive waves with denser zombie spawns; challenge mode for score attack

games.retention_answer: Continuous plant unlocks through Adventure progression, multiple game modes (Adventure, Survival, Puzzle, Mini-Games, Zen), endless mode score attack, achievement/trophy collection, strategic plant synergy discovery

loops.minute_1: Place Militia Tower (melee deploy), or Archer Tower (ranged). Enemies spawn from entry point, travel predefined path. First tower fires immediately, feedback establishes tower role
loops.minute_10: Levels 2-3, 2-3 tower types in play. Player discovers armor=needs Mage, speed=needs Archer+Militia block. Star collection begins (1-3 stars per level based on condition)
loops.hour_5: Levels 8-15 (Kingdoms completed), 8-15 stars accumulated. Star tree active: each upgrade costs stars permanently. Economic pressure = upgrade which tower type or start new level?
loops.endgame: Heroic Challenge mode: same levels, higher difficulty (+50-100% enemy HP/armor). Iron Challenge: extreme modifiers. Players replay campaigns to 3-star every level for star tree completion

objectives.victory_condition: Survive all enemy waves in designated level without enemies reaching end of path
objectives.defeat_condition: Enemy unit reaches right edge of path (escape condition), or player gold depleted and unable to defend
objectives.player_goal: Earn 1-3 stars per level by achieving conditions (defeat all waves, bonus gold, units alive); stars unlock permanent tower upgrades

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat all enemy waves with increased difficulty (+50-100% enemy stats)
objectives.player_goal: Prove mastery on higher difficulty; earn additional stars and leaderboard ranking

objectives.victory_condition: Extreme difficulty variant; defeat all waves with stacked modifiers
objectives.player_goal: Ultimate endgame; compete for leaderboard position against best players

games.retention_answer: Star progression unlocks permanent tower buffs (incentivizes replay for 3-star completion), heroic/iron challenges scale difficulty indefinitely, hero collectibles, leaderboards per challenge, new kingdoms added in updates

loops.minute_1: Place Cannon tower on elevated ground (blocks enemy path if used tactically). First wave preview visible. Enemy path layout understood immediately. Cannon fires at approaching enemies
loops.minute_10: Waves 2-5, tower mix (Cannon + Inferno for swarmers, Gun for armored). Rewind function tested (allows restart after wave preview). First upgrade decision (Cannon Tier 2 costs significant cash)
loops.hour_5: Missions 4-7, 5+ towers active with mixed tier-2 upgrades. Cash pressure = upgrade existing choke point vs deploy new tower. Wave preview reading becomes predictive strategy
loops.endgame: Rematch modes: same mission, 1-3 modifiers active (Time Warp: speed+, Regicide: kill boss first, Reversible: enemies reverse direction). Score leaderboard per modifier combo. Victory = complete mission, scoring = leaderboard rank

objectives.victory_condition: Defend core from all enemy waves and prevent any creep from stealing core and escaping
objectives.defeat_condition: Core stolen by enemy (creep reaches core, escapes with it) or tower placement blocked critical path
objectives.player_goal: Place and upgrade towers to intercept all enemy waves; earn cash from kills

objectives.victory_condition: Complete mission while modifier(s) active (e.g., Time Warp +50% speed, Regicide mode)
objectives.player_goal: Maximize score with active modifiers for leaderboard competition

games.retention_answer: Modifier-based rematch system creates new leaderboards per modifier combo, wave preview mastery rewards strategic planning, tower upgrade trees encourage optimization, detailed scoring (efficiency bonuses), achievement tracking

retention_synthesis: Tower Defense genre unifies on 4 repeating patterns: (1) immediate cash→tower→kill loop that teaches economy in <1min, (2) early tower diversification forcing player to discover role synergies (3) mid-game economic pressure that rewards mastery of tradeoffs, (4) endgame divergence where games choose between ramping difficulty (Bloons infinite), score-chase survival (PvZ Endless), or modifier-scaled leaderboards (Kingdom Rush/Defense Grid). Retention is driven by: permanent progression (star trees, paragon unlock), new content drops (tower/unit additions), and leaderboard incentives. Player returns to optimize strategy, not to 'beat' the game — tower defense is inherently about score-chase and sandbox optimization. High replayability tied directly to asymmetric endgame choice: bounded (level-based) vs unbounded (infinite ramping).
